description: Based on Fabian Giesen's interleaved entropy coders, structure the decode so that a single DEFLATE bitstream is logically treated as multiple interleaved sub-streams at the decoder level. Rather than modifying the format, use sync-point discovery to create virtual interleaving points. This enables the ILP benefits of multi-stream decoding within a format that only has one stream.
mathematical_formalization: Given bitstream B of length L bits and N interleave points at positions {p_1, ..., p_N}, create virtual streams VS_i = B[p_i..p_{i+1}]. The interleaving schedule: decode 1 symbol from each VS in round-robin. Latency L_total = K * L_one / N + sync_overhead.
implementation_hypothesis: For a DEFLATE block with known compressed size, find N-1 sync points at evenly-spaced intervals. Initialize N independent bit-buffer states. The inner loop alternates decoding from each stream.
experiment_seed: Implement 2-way and 4-way virtual interleaving for the Huffman decode phase. Measure throughput improvement on Skylake. Find the minimum block size where interleaving is beneficial.
